title: 第 12 章 好大的茶味啊
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
陈默不一会的功夫就已经回到了自己的住处。

    推开院门走进去的时候天已经快晌午了。

    只见周玄正坐在院子里的石凳上不知道在想些什么。

    看到陈默进来他立刻站了起来脸上的表情写满了担忧。

    “陈默你可算回来了。”

    “怎么了？”陈默看着他。

    “你还问我怎么了？我都听说了你刚刚竟然打了陆云师兄是不是？”

    此时周玄倒吸了一口凉气。

    看到陈默点头这才意识到竟然是真的，他刚才听别的弟子说起这件事的时候还以为是在开玩笑。

    没想到陈默真的把陆云给打了。

    要知道陆云可是金丹大圆满啊，在整个外门可以说是数一数二的存在。

    这陈默怎么敢对他动手啊。

    “陆云师兄是大长老的弟子，你打了他大长老能饶了你吗？”

    “打都打了还能怎么样。”他淡淡道。

    “现在说什么都晚了哎都怪我。”

    周玄自责的低下了头，“要不是因为我的话你也不会得罪陆瑶更不会得罪陆云。”

    “要不是我让你去要灵石事情也不会变成现在这样，是我连累了你。”

    说完之后他眼眶都有些泛红了。

    而陈默看着他拍了拍他的肩膀。

    “跟你没关系。”

    “怎么没关系要不是我……”

    “陆云那个人我早就看不顺眼了，就算没有你的事我也会找机会收拾他。”

    此刻的周玄正抬起头看着他。

    “真的？”

    “可是大长老那边……”

    “大长老那边不用担心，你先回去养伤别想这些了。”

    这时周玄张了张嘴想说点什么可看到陈默那副淡然的表情到嘴边的话又咽了回去。

    “那好吧，你自己小心点。”

    说完他便转身回了自己的屋里。

    正当陈默在院子里站了一会儿正准备回屋的时候院门外传来一阵脚步声。

    他转过头看过去。

    一个穿着绿色长裙的年轻女子站在院门口，她的容貌清秀，气质温婉看起来倒是挺养眼的。

    而陈默已经认出了她。

    这女人的名字叫姜初然。
content_en:
Chen Mo returned to his residence in a short while.

    It was almost noon when I opened the courtyard door and walked in.

    I saw Zhou Xuan sitting on the stone bench in the yard wondering what he was thinking.

    When he saw Chen Mo come in, he immediately stood up, the expression on his face was full of worry.

    "Chen Mo, you are finally back."

    "What's wrong?" Chen Mo looked at him.

    "You're still asking me what's wrong? I've heard that you just hit Senior Brother Lu Yun, right?"

    At this time, Zhou Xuan took a breath of cold air.

    Seeing Chen Mo nod, he realized that it was true. He thought it was a joke when he heard other disciples talk about it just now.

    Unexpectedly, Chen Mo actually beat Lu Yun.

    You must know that Lu Yun is the Golden Elixir Great Perfection, which can be said to be one of the best in the entire outer sect.

    How dare Chen Mo do something to him.

    "Senior Brother Lu Yun is the disciple of the Great Elder. If you beat him, will the Great Elder spare you?"

    "I've already beaten you, so what can I do?" He said calmly.

    "It's too late to say anything now. It's all my fault."

    Zhou Xuan lowered his head in self-reproach, "If it weren't for me, you wouldn't have offended Lu Yao, let alone Lu Yun."

    "If I hadn't asked you to get the spirit stone, things wouldn't be like this. It was me who got you involved."

    After saying that, his eyes were a little red.

    Chen Mo looked at him and patted his shoulder.

    "It has nothing to do with you."

    "Why doesn't it matter if it wasn't for me..."

    "I've long disliked Lu Yun. Even if it didn't have anything to do with you, I would still find an opportunity to deal with him."

    At this moment, Zhou Xuan was raising his head and looking at him.

    "Really?"

    "But the great elder..."

    "Don't worry about it, Great Elder. You go back to recuperate first and don't think about this."

    At this time, Zhou Xuan opened his mouth to say something, but when he saw Chen Mo's indifferent expression, he swallowed the words back.

    "Well, be careful yourself."

    After saying that, he turned around and went back to his room.

    Just as Chen Mo stood in the yard for a while and was about to go back to the house, there was a sound of footsteps outside the yard door.

    He turned and looked over.

    A young woman wearing a green dress stood at the entrance of the courtyard. She had a delicate appearance and a gentle temperament, which looked quite eye-catching.

    And Chen Mo had already recognized her.

    This woman's name is Jiang Churan.
